Cudy WR1300E V2 AC1200 Mesh Router | Dual Band 1200Mbps Wi-Fi 5 with Gigabit Ports

Upgrade your home or office network with the Cudy WR1300E V2 AC1200 Mesh Router, offering fast and reliable wireless speeds of up to 1200Mbps. With dual band connectivity (300Mbps on 2.4GHz + 867Mbps on 5GHz), this router is perfect for smooth 4K streaming, online gaming, video conferencing, and smart home usage.

Equipped with Gigabit Ethernet ports, it delivers high-speed wired connections for desktops, smart TVs, gaming consoles, and more. The mesh capability ensures seamless Wi-Fi coverage across your entire home, eliminating dead zones and allowing devices to switch automatically to the strongest signal.

Key Features:

  • Dual Band AC1200 Speed – 2.4GHz (300Mbps) + 5GHz (867Mbps) for smooth performance
  • Wi-Fi 5 Technology – Faster speeds, wider coverage, and better stability
  • Mesh-Ready Design – Supports mesh networking for whole-home coverage
  • Gigabit LAN/WAN Ports – Lightning-fast wired connectivity
  • Parental Controls & Guest Network – Keep your family and data safe
  • WPA3 Security – Advanced protection against cyber threats
  • Easy Setup via Cudy App – Manage your network anytime, anywhere
